Entire pick head is wood, no metal. Upright centred tool, front three-quarter view with negligible foreshortening, shaft vertical, pick head across upper third, full silhouette visible, no hands or person. Head width about 70 percent of canvas, whole handle and head fill about 88 percent of height. Consistent crisp painterly game-item art readable at 40px, restrained highlights, no glow. Transparent background, no text, no label, no additional objects, no ground shadow, no border. This will be attached to a character's hand and used as the actual mining tool.
